name: Open Source Norsk Nynorsk
statement: Translated by the free-bible project from the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (tanach.us) and The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition (Michael W. Holmes, ed., SBL and Logos Bible Software, 2010). No credit is required for this project's own work, but the source texts must be credited: the SBLGNT under CC BY 4.0 with a link to https://sblgnt.com, and the Hebrew text to https://www.tanach.us. Because the SBLGNT is CC BY 4.0, that obligation carries over to this translation and to anything derived from it.
